note: Labels and ground truth are not model input. Requests are expanded by tests/openclaw/make_connected_messages.py from item facts in connected-ground-truth.json at a pinned commit.

outcomes.LOCAL: all items answerable and the owner wants answers: decision LOCAL, no draft
outcomes.HYBRID: decision PREVIEW; local_summary records what was resolved locally; the draft request holds only the residue
outcomes.OUTSOURCE_FULL: decision PREVIEW; every item stays in the draft request; a local pass may be added if labelled non-independent
outcomes.OUTSOURCE_RESIDUE_ONLY: nothing could be resolved locally: decision PREVIEW with every item in the draft request and no verdicts
outcomes.NEEDS_SCOPE_RESIDUAL: local results reported, residue exists, no sharing approval or procurement choice: NEEDS_SCOPE and no draft
outcomes.UNSUITABLE: sensitive or out-of-pilot: UNSUITABLE, no draft, no fetch
